نكتنز (form VIII)
# نَكْتَنِزُ (naktanizu) /nak.ta.ni.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# نُكْتَنَزُ (nuktanazu) /nuk.ta.na.zu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# نَكْتَنِزَ (naktaniza) /nak.ta.ni.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# نُكْتَنَزَ (nuktanaza) /nuk.ta.na.za/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
